title: Adminer
descript: Adminer packaged for TerraMaster TOS 7. It runs the official Docker Hub image inside a container on your NAS, keeps all of its data in an application data folder (so it survives restarts and updates), and is opened from its desktop icon.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the initial setup. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/adminerdocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.
